sources.title: Google Ads: Budgets overview
sources.claim_scope: Average daily budget versus daily and monthly limits
sources.evidence_summary: Official page states that for most campaigns daily spending limit is 2 times average daily budget and monthly limit is 30.4 times it; account and campaign details require checking.

sources.title: Google Ads: About enhanced conversions
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed content states hashed first-party data supplements existing conversion measurement. No universal privacy or performance guarantee inferred.

sources.title: Google Ads: Campaign experiment definition
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed content describes parallel experiment using original traffic and budget over a specified duration.

sources.title: Meta: Instagram and Facebook Reels ads
sources.evidence_summary: Official indexed page describes vertical creative, audio, safe zones, placement options and A/B testing. Published vendor uplift figures not adopted.

sources.title: Meta Engineering: GEM Training at LLM Scale
sources.evidence_summary: Official engineering article describes GEM as a foundation model for advertising recommendations across Instagram and Facebook and discusses training infrastructure.

sources.title: R stats: Power Calculations for Two-Sample Test for Proportions
sources.evidence_summary: Official R documentation specifies sample size per group, p1, p2, significance and power parameters. The book labels its simple formula an approximation rather than the exact R calculation.

sources.title: Huthwaite International: The SPIN Methodology
sources.evidence_summary: Authoritative methodology provider describes Situation, Problem, Implication and Need-payoff questions. Book applications are original and vendor outcome claims are not adopted.

sources.title: MEDDICC: MEDDPICC Sales Methodology and Process
sources.evidence_summary: Provider page describes metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria/process, paper process, pain, champion and competition and the role of complex buying processes.

sources.title: FTC: Endorsement Guides — What People Are Asking
sources.evidence_summary: Official guidance discusses material connections, endorsements and affiliate relationships; book does not extrapolate it into worldwide compliance.

sources.title: FTC Announces Updated Advertising Guides to Combat Deceptive Reviews and Endorsements
sources.claim_scope: Revision date and nature of guidance
sources.evidence_summary: Official release announces revised endorsement guidance dated June 29, 2023.

limitations.consequence: No current API parameter or deduplication rule claimed from blocked page.
No precise Advantage+ account eligibility or current control claim.
FTC guidance is US context; global outreach and privacy requirements require separate verification.
Undated pages have null publication_date. Retrieval on cutoff date does not establish when each page was updated.
